content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases and SQL
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL Commands (SELECT, FROM, WHERE)
    - Lesson 3: Joins (INNER, OUTER, LEFT, RIGHT JOINS)
    - Lesson 4: Understanding Data Types and Functions in SQL
    - Lesson 5: Aggregations (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)
    - Lesson 6: ORDER BY Clause and Sorting Data
    - Lesson 7: WHERE Clause and Filtering Data
    - Lesson 8: Group By Clause and Grouping Data
    - Lesson 9: Subqueries in SQL
    - Lesson 10: Advanced Joins (Self-joins, Cross joins)

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and Jupyter Notebooks
    - Lesson 2: Python Libraries for Data Analysis (NumPy, Pandas)
    - Lesson 3: Reading and Writing CSV Files with Pandas
    - Lesson 4: Data Manipulation with Pandas (Merging, Filtering, Grouping)
    - Lesson 5: Handling Missing Values and Data Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 6: Data Visualization with Matplotlib (Bar Charts, Histograms)
    - Lesson 7: Advanced Data Visualization with Seaborn
    - Lesson 8: Working with Dates and Time Series Data in Pandas

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Exploring and Understanding Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Handling Missing Values (Imputation Techniques)
    - Lesson 3: Removing Outliers and Anomalies
    - Lesson 4: Data Normalization and Transformation
    - Lesson 5: Text Preprocessing for Natural Language Processing
    - Lesson 6: One-hot encoding and Label Encoding
    - Lesson 7: Feature Extraction and Feature Engineering
    - Lesson 8: Dataset Splitting (Training, Validation, Testing)

   Track: Statistics for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Descriptive Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, Range)
    - Lesson 2: Probability Distributions (Normal Distribution, Binomial Distribution)
    - Lesson 3: Hypothesis Testing (T-test, Chi-square test)
    - Lesson 4: Correlation and Regression Analysis
    - Lesson 5: Confidence Intervals and Margin of Error
    - Lesson 6: ANOVA (Analysis of Variance)
    - Lesson 7: Non-parametric Tests (Wilcoxon Rank Sum Test, Kruskal–Wallis test)
    - Lesson 8: Inferential Statistics and Decision Making

   Track: Introduction to Machine Learning
    - Lesson 1: Supervised vs Unsupervised Learning
    - Lesson 2: Regression Analysis (Simple Linear Regression, Multiple Linear Regression)
    - Lesson 3: Classification Algorithms (Logistic Regression, Decision Trees)
    - Lesson 4: Clustering Algorithms (K-means Clustering, Hierarchical Clustering)
    - Lesson 5: Model Evaluation and Validation
    - Lesson 6: Overfitting and Underfitting in Machine Learning Models
    - Lesson 7: Ensemble Methods (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting)
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Deep Learning with Neural Networks

   Track: Capstone Project: Applying Skills to Real-World Data
    - Lesson 1: Choosing a Dataset and Defining the Problem
    - Lesson 2: Preprocessing and Cleaning the Dataset
    - Lesson 3: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and Visualizing the Data
    - Lesson 4: Feature Engineering and Model Building
    - Lesson 5: Model Training, Validation, and Evaluation
    - Lesson 6: Optimizing the Model for Better Performance
    - Lesson 7: Presenting Findings and Interpreting Results
    - Lesson 8: Reflecting on the Project and Planning Next Steps
